summary: Master the art of business research with our specialized training. Learn effective methods, techniques, and tools to make informed decisions and drive sucess.
lede: Business research methods turn management concerns into answerable questions through structured evidence gathering and analysis. For professionals who commission, conduct, manage, or use research, the course covers defining research questions, choosing sampling and qualitative or quantitative methods, and assessing evidence quality. Learners also practice interpreting findings and presenting actionable recommendations in reports and dashboards.
audienceIntro: Business Research Methods suits professionals who commission, conduct, analyze, manage, or use business research across functional and industry settings. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured research workflow rather than advanced statistical engineering.
modules: Quantitative Analysis with Excel and SPSS
prerequisites: You need basic computer literacy and familiarity with workplace documents or spreadsheets. You do not need prior experience with research software, statistical programming, or formal academic research. Bring a business issue, customer question, workforce issue, process concern, or strategic decision that could support a practical research exercise. Training exercises use sample datasets and templates, so confidential organizational data is not required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
